items.title: Nike Moves on Investor Day; Lowe's Reports Earnings | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Lowe's (LOW) is also reporting its earnings this morning, a day after competitor Home Depot reported. Bloomberg Intelligence cites steady demand and data from Placer.ai which points to foot-traffic trends similar to the second quarter. - Nike (NKE) shares are moving following its investor day. The company is projecting a return to market-level expansion in the fiscal year through May 2029, but challenges in its Jordan and Converse brands, as well as its sportswear business, don't have an immediate fix. - Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) shares are jumping in premarket as its major video game Grand Theft Auto VI is an open-world game set in Vice City, a fictionalized version of Miami, with lifelike graphical fidelity.

items.title: Home Depot Q3 Earnings Call Flags Margin Pressure as Sales Grow
items.summary: HD expects 4.5% sales growth in fiscal 2026 but faces margin pressure from shifting sales mix, acquisitions and softer home improvement demand.
